plugin.name: StateGraph Maven Plugin
plugin.description: Generates the StateGraph typed API of a Maven project and runs the verified compilation lifecycle around javac.

mojo.description: Emits the typed StateGraph vocabulary of the main compilation and the manifest the annotation processor reads, and adds the generated directory as a compile source root. Does nothing in a project packaged as pom, or when maven.main.skip or <skipMain> switches the main compilation off.

parameter.name: project
parameter.description: The project this compilation belongs to. Every source root, class output and build directory of the request is read from it.

parameter.name: session
parameter.description: The session this build runs in. It is what the toolchain manager resolves the selected jdk toolchain against.

parameter.name: pluginArtifacts
parameter.description: The artifacts of this plugin, which carry the generator this goal starts. The dependencies of the project being built are never on that classpath.

parameter.name: javaExecutable
parameter.description: The java executable the generator runs under. Left unset, the goal uses the java of the jdk toolchain selected for the build, else the java of the JVM running Maven. Whichever it is must belong to a JDK 21 or later, and to the JDK javac compiles with.

parameter.name: compilationId
parameter.description: The identity of this compilation. Left unset, the goal uses groupId:artifactId:main for the main source set and groupId:artifactId:test for the test one.
